rule.description: ISO 32000-1:2008, 9.7.4, Table 117 requires that all embedded Type 2 CIDFonts in the CIDFont dictionary shall contain a CIDToGIDMap entry that shall be a stream mapping from CIDs to glyph indices or the name Identity, as described in ISO 32000-1:2008, 9.7.4, Table 117

check.errorMessage: A Type 2 CIDFont dictionary has missing or invalid CIDToGIDMap entry

rule.description: An annotation (except Widget annotations or hidden annotations, or those having rectangle outside the crop-box) shall have either Contents key or an Alt entry in the enclosing structure element
rule.test: Subtype == 'Widget' || isOutsideCropBox == true || (F & 2) == 2 || (Contents != null && Contents != '') || (Alt != null && Alt != '')

check.errorMessage: FreeText annotation whose hidden flag is not set and whose rectangle is not outside the crop-box has neither Contents key nor an Alt entry in the enclosing structure element

rule.description: An annotation, excluding annotations of subtype Widget, PrinterMark or Link, shall be nested within an Annot tag
rule.test: Subtype == 'Widget' || Subtype == 'PrinterMark' || Subtype == 'Link' || isOutsideCropBox == true || (F & 2) == 2 || structParentStandardType == 'Annot'
